title: pipeline writes article to IPFS before msgid dedup check — duplicate article gets stored
description: In run_pipeline (pipeline.rs), step 1 calls ipfs.put_raw() BEFORE step 2 calls msgid_map.insert(). There is a race: two concurrent pipeline invocations for the same article (e.g. from two simultaneous peering sessions that both passed check_ingest before either stored) will both write to IPFS and both call msgid_map.insert(). The second msgid_map.insert() will hit ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING and silently succeed, leaving a duplicate IPFS block orphaned with no articles-table row. The pipeline IPFS write should not happen before the msgid uniqueness is ensured.
